fileNodes.name: AGENTS.md
fileNodes.summary: Fishblitz development guide for AI agents: the eight design-philosophy principles (no villains/bad luck, restoration-as-adaptation, Presences kept ambiguous, narrative through play, biased storytelling, costly resources, slow community return, season-driven drama), agent communication style, C# code style conventions (PascalCase, _camelCase fields, ReactiveUnity Reactive<T> properties, Logger, NUnit asserts), common Unity patterns (RequireComponent, coroutines, Input System OnMove), tech stack notes (URP, Cinemachine, BlueOyster JSON saves, custom shaders), a complete FlyingChaser prefab setup recipe, and pointers to agent skill docs (issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs).

fileNodes.name: IDEAS.md
fileNodes.summary: Design source of truth for Fishblitz. Defines the premise (player arrives in an abandoned, season-organized region and repairs it, villagers return, a disaster hits each season) and opening sequence; themes (no bad people, only bad luck, living within limits, community drama of adaptation and repair); the deliberately ambiguous Presences (River, Forest, Winter) and storytelling rules (brief dialogue, audio-overlay for long content, environment reinforces story). Details the Way North river progression with bow-and-arrow combat and stealth, the full Trail of the Brother backstory (Patrick, June, Maron, the River Presence, the player), and gameplay systems: mushroom foraging with mix-and-match traits, diet/stamina bars, box rewards (wheelbarrow/bow/crouch), birding via ScriptableObjects, drought and four transition seasons, Three Sisters farming, fire system, and fire ecology wood types.

fileNodes.name: README.md
fileNodes.summary: Project overview: Fishblitz is a top-down pixel art RPG that began as a game-jam fishing game and grew into an expansive RPG, with a link to an early demo on itch.io. Lists the core gameplay loop (fell trees, split firewood, light fires, sleep, fish, go birding) and a short 'what I've learned' section covering Unity/C# experience, design patterns, physics, shaders, and AI.

fileNodes.name: BurstAotSettings_StandaloneOSX.json

fileNodes.name: BurstAotSettings_WebGL.json
fileNodes.summary: Burst AOT compiler settings for the WebGL build target. Enables Burst compilation and optimisations with safety checks off, but omits a CPU target list since WebGL has no specific CPU target selection.

fileNodes.name: ProjectVersion.txt
fileNodes.summary: Records the Unity Editor version the project is opened with: 6000.3.10f1 (revision e35f0c77bd8e). This pins the editor version despite the project aiming for Unity 2022.3+.

fileNodes.name: SceneTemplateSettings.json
fileNodes.summary: Scene template pin/dependency settings for the Unity Scene Template system. Registers dependency types (AnimationClip, AnimatorController, Material, Shader, Texture, SceneAsset, etc.) with default instantiation modes — assets like MonoScript, Shader, and SceneAsset default to a copy; textures and materials default to referencing the original.

fileNodes.name: domain.md
fileNodes.summary: Agent-workflow doc telling engineering skills how to consume the repo's domain documentation before exploring: read CONTEXT.md (or CONTEXT-MAP.md pointing at per-context CONTEXT.md files) and any relevant docs/adr/ entries, proceeding silently if they are absent. Shows single-context and multi-context directory layouts, requires using the glossary's vocabulary in agent output, and demands that output contradicting an existing ADR be flagged explicitly rather than silently overridden. The /domain-modeling skill (reached via /grill-with-docs and /improve-codebase-architecture) creates these docs lazily.

fileNodes.name: issue-tracker.md
fileNodes.summary: Defines GitHub as the repo's issue tracker, driven entirely through the gh CLI with concrete conventions for creating, reading, listing, commenting on, labelling, and closing issues, plus a flag (currently 'no') controlling whether external PRs act as a triage surface. Also documents the wayfinding operations used by /wayfinder: a wayfinder:map issue holding child tickets linked as GitHub sub-issues with native blocked_by dependencies, a frontier query that drops blocked or assigned children, and claim/resolve workflows.

fileNodes.name: triage-labels.md
fileNodes.summary: Maps the five canonical triage role names from mattpocock/skills to this repo's actual GitHub label strings: needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human, and wontfix, each with its meaning. Skills that mention a role apply the local label string from this table; the right-hand column is meant to be edited to match whatever vocabulary this repo actually uses.

fileNodes.name: AudioPlayerManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Archived legacy singleton audio player manager. Keeps a single AudioSource alive across scene loads via DontDestroyOnLoad and plays its clip on Start. Superseded by AudioManager in Assets/Scripts/Base Systems.

fileNodes.name: MyDebugger.cs
fileNodes.summary: Archived debug helper exposing a context-menu 'Test' action that reads a serialized Tilemap's tile at a cell and prints its GameObject via TileBase.GetTileData. Reference/template code for tile data inspection.

fileNodes.name: fish blitz.inputactions
fileNodes.summary: Unity Input System action asset defining six input maps: Player (Move, UseItem, Interact, OpenInventory, ItemSelect1-10, MoveItemCursor, OnClick, ToggleMenu, Crouch), Birding (Rotate, Move, UseBinoculars), PlayerBarrowing, Combat (UseTool), UI (Navigate/Submit/Cancel/Point/Click/etc.), and Menu (MoveCursor/ToggleMenu/Select). Binds keyboard/mouse, gamepad, touch, joystick and XR control schemes.

fileNodes.name: DOTween.XML
fileNodes.summary: XML API documentation for the DOTween tweening library's DG.Tweening namespace: ~520 members covering Tween/Tweener/Sequence, DOVirtual, DOTween settings and initialization, plugins, easing, enums (Ease, LoopType, PathType, RotateMode, etc.) and Core internals.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenEditor.XML
fileNodes.summary: XML API documentation for DOTween's Unity editor tooling: EditorCompatibilityUtils, DOTweenEditorPreview (play/stop/prepare tweens in edit mode), EditorUtils (setup detection, ADB path conversion, global defines, ScriptableObject asset connection), and version helpers.

fileNodes.name: readme.txt
fileNodes.summary: DOTween package readme: upgrade instructions (reimport, reopen Unity, run Setup DOTween from Tools > Demigiant), module add/remove notes, usage (`using DG.Tweening`), and links to docs/license. Third-party library notice by Demigiant.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleAudio.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module adding audio tween extensions: DOFade/DOPitch on AudioSource, DOSetFloat on AudioMixer exposed floats, and operation shortcuts (DOComplete/DOKill/DOFlip/DOPlay/DOPlayBackwards/DORestart/DORewind/DOTogglePause etc.) targeting an AudioMixer.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleEPOOutline.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween integration for the EPO Outline package (compiled only when the EPO_DOTWEEN define is set). Extends SerializedPass, Outlinable.OutlineProperties and Outliner with DOFloat/DOFade/DOColor/DOVector/DOBlurShift/DODilateShift and DOKill. Disabled in this project since the define is absent.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for 3D physics: DOMove/DOMoveX/Y/Z, DORotate, DOLookAt, DOJump (sequence with yoyo arc), and DOPath/DOLocalPath waypoint tweens for Rigidbody.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModulePhysics2D.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for 2D physics: DOMove/DOMoveX/Y, DORotate, DOJump, and DOPath/DOLocalPath waypoint tweens for Rigidbody2D.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleSprite.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for SpriteRenderer: DOColor, DOFade (alpha), DOGradientColor (chained sequence), and blendable DOBlendableColor.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleUI.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module for uGUI: extensions for CanvasGroup, Graphic, Image, LayoutElement, Outline, RectTransform (anchored position/anchors/pivot/sizeDelta, punch/shake/jump), ScrollRect, Slider, and Text (DOText, DOCounter), plus blendable colors, DOShapeCircle, and a Utils.SwitchToRectTransform helper.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleUnityVersion.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween module with Unity-version-gated helpers: Material gradient/offset/tiling tweens, coroutine yield instructions (WaitForCompletion/Rewind/Kill/ElapsedLoops/Position/Start via DOTweenCYInstruction), and async/await waiters for tweens.

fileNodes.name: DOTweenModuleUtils.cs
fileNodes.summary: Third-party DOTween utility module: reflection-driven Init (wires SetOrientationOnPath and editor playmode hook), a reflection Preserver, and a nested Physics helper (SetOrientationOnPath, HasRigidbody(2D), CreateDOTweenPathTween) that dispatches path tweens to Rigidbody, Rigidbody2D, or Transform.

fileNodes.name: AudioManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Global audio service exposed as static AudioManager.Instance. PlayMusic sets a looping music clip and fades it in over 2s; PlaySFX/PlayLoopingSFX play SoundData clips with randomized volume/pitch; looping SFX re-fire with organic spacing via a coroutine and can fade in/out, returning a stop action.

fileNodes.name: Bootstrapper.cs
fileNodes.summary: Scene bootstrap that instantiates persistent prefabs (DontDestroyOnLoad, deduped by name), all-scene prefabs, then scene-type-specific (Inside/Outside) prefabs from a BootstrapperConfig, then destroys itself.

fileNodes.name: DynamicPixelPerfectCamera.cs
fileNodes.summary: Pixel-perfect orthographic camera that follows the player, clamps within a world Collider2D bounds, recomputes ortho size when resolution changes (height-based scaling with pixelsPerUnit/scaleFactor), and forces fullscreen on start.

fileNodes.name: DynamicSpriteSorting.cs
fileNodes.summary: Utility that continuously sets a SpriteRenderer or SortingGroup sortingOrder from -Y position (y-sort), so sprites depth-sort by world height. Asserts one of the two components exists.

fileNodes.name: FloodDamage.cs
fileNodes.summary: On start, if WorldState.WaterState is Flood, destroys 'impermanent' child objects whose world position falls on a tile of any serialized damaged-area Tilemap, applying flood damage to the scene.

fileNodes.name: GameClock.cs
fileNodes.summary: Singleton in-game clock. Accumulates real time into game minutes (configurable day length in real minutes), derives minute/hour/day/season/year and current day period from elapsed minutes, fires OnGameMinute/Hour/Day/Season/YearTick events, supports skipping/pausing time, and exposes a GameIsPaused Reactive<bool>.

fileNodes.name: GridCursor.cs
fileNodes.summary: Player-facing grid cursor with 8 directional visual cursors that swap as the player's facing direction changes (subscribed via PlayerMovement.Direction OnChange). Exposes GridPosition and Collider, and provides FindObjectAtGridCursor<T> (physics overlap) and FindInteractableTileMapByTags (tagged Tilemap lookup).

fileNodes.name: HeatSensitive.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tracks ambient IHeatSource in range, gathered from serialized MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject source lists, recomputes the hottest Temperature into a protected Reactive<Temperature>, prunes destroyed sources, and exposes Temperature via AddHeatSource/RemoveHeatSource.

fileNodes.name: HeatSource.cs
fileNodes.summary: Declares the Temperature enum (Freezing, Cold, Normal, Warm, Hot — order matters as logic relies on numeric value) and the IHeatSource interface exposing a Temperature property.

fileNodes.name: ISaveableComponent.cs
fileNodes.summary: Save contract interface: components expose a ComponentId plus CaptureStateAsJson/RestoreStateFromJson so the save system can persist their state as JSON.

fileNodes.name: IntroManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Intro/initialization flow: resets player systems (energy/drying/temperature/strength, inventory, carry, wheelbarrow), wipes the persistent data folder, optionally plays a Narrator intro, then sets a pending spawn position (named spawn or custom) and loads the initial scene via LevelChanger.

fileNodes.name: LocalHeatSource.cs
fileNodes.summary: Localized heat source component implementing IHeatSource. Uses a Collider2D trigger to register/unregister itself with overlapping HeatSensitive components, exposing a settable Temperature that re-registers the source with nearby heat sensitives.

fileNodes.name: Magnetosphere.cs
fileNodes.summary: Player magnet for magnetic LooseItems: items in a magnet range are pulled toward the player with an inverse-square force and collected into the Inventory when they intersect a collect collider.

fileNodes.name: MatchLightWithSun.cs
fileNodes.summary: Small component that mirrors the global SunLightControl's current intensity and color onto a local Light2D every LateUpdate, so interior lights track the sun.

fileNodes.name: Narrator.cs
fileNodes.summary: Scene-level singleton that queues and displays short narrative messages as pixel-text overlays, running on unscaled time so narration continues during pause. Also prints first-visit scene messages on entering a scene for the first time.

fileNodes.name: ObjectPooling.cs
fileNodes.summary: Simple static GameObject object pool. SpawnObject reuses an inactive pooled instance or instantiates a new one; ReturnObjectToPool deactivates and stores objects under their pool key.

fileNodes.name: OccupyWorldObjectSpace.cs
fileNodes.summary: Marks a world object as occupying a rectangular tile footprint (configured by extra-tile fields) on the scene's WorldObjectOccupancyMap while enabled, and frees that space on disable.

fileNodes.name: OutsideTemperature.cs
fileNodes.summary: Singleton IHeatSource representing outdoor ambient temperature, backed by WorldState.OutsideTemperature. On temperature change or scene load it re-registers itself with all HeatSensitive components on the player and under the scene Grid.

fileNodes.name: Persistence.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static JSON persistence helper (namespace ColePersistence) that serializes/deserializes objects with Newtonsoft.Json into Application.persistentDataPath, with exists and delete helpers.

fileNodes.name: PickUpOnInteract.cs
fileNodes.summary: Interactable pickup: on cursor interaction adds a fixed item quantity to the player's inventory, plays a pickup sound, and destroys the object, or posts a no-space message.

fileNodes.name: ReduceOpacityWhenPlayerBehind.cs
fileNodes.summary: Fades a visual (SpriteRenderer, Image, CanvasGroup, or a SortingGroup's child sprites) to a lower opacity while the player's collider overlaps, and restores it on exit.

fileNodes.name: SaveData.cs
fileNodes.summary: Serializable per-world-object save payload: identifier, persistent ID, position (via SimpleVector3), and extended JSON data. Defines the ISaveable component contract and instantiates prefabs back from Resources on load.

fileNodes.name: SceneSaveLoadManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Central save/load manager: persists each scene's world objects (children of the Impermanent container) to a per-scene JSON file, persists global player-component state, replays elapsed game-time ticks on load, and manages the first-visit flag.

fileNodes.name: SceneSpawner.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tilemap-driven world object spawner. Reads marker tiles and SpawnObjectInfo configs, filters candidate positions by occupancy, object footprint size, Perlin noise, and near-type proximity, then instantiates prefab variants on first visit only.

fileNodes.name: SelectRandomSprite.cs
fileNodes.summary: Picks a sprite from a weighted list at Start using the object's world position as a deterministic random seed, so identical objects in different cells get varied but stable sprites.

fileNodes.name: SleepMenu.cs
fileNodes.summary: Sleep sequence: pauses the game clock, computes energy recovered from sleep quality and diet, waits for narration to clear, applies recovered energy, skips to the next morning, and re-enters the scene via LevelChanger.

fileNodes.name: SoundData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject audio asset describing a clip with volume, looping, pitch/volume variation, fade in/out, and loop-spacing options consumed by the audio managers.

fileNodes.name: SoundDataEditor.cs
fileNodes.summary: Custom Unity editor inspector for SoundData that conditionally reveals pitch/volume variation fields and looping sub-fields (fade, spacing) with indentation.

fileNodes.name: SpawnItems.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static helper for spawning loose item pickups: scatters item stacks within a collider or at explicit positions, applies an optional launch velocity/drag direction, and loads items from Resources.

fileNodes.name: SpawnObjectInfo.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject spawn configuration for SceneSpawner: prefab variants, valid world tile types, density, optional near-type adjacency, and optional Perlin noise gating.

fileNodes.name: SpriteLocalCoords.cs
fileNodes.summary: EditMode component that pushes a sprite's UV-remap vector (from its texture rect and texel size) into the material via MaterialPropertyBlock, or via a material instance in play mode.

fileNodes.name: SpriteSubdivider.cs
fileNodes.summary: Subdivides a SpriteRenderer's sprite into a grid of vertices/triangles using OverrideGeometry, optionally on a cloned sprite, to enable per-segment sprite deformation effects.

fileNodes.name: UseItem.cs
fileNodes.summary: Player item-use driver: queues use input, resolves the target under the grid cursor, and routes item usage through interfaces (IUsableOnWorldObject, IUsableOnTileMap, IUsableWithoutTarget), depleting energy and playing hit sounds on successful use.

fileNodes.name: VirtualCameraManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Cinemachine camera manager that warps the virtual camera to the player's scene spawn position on scene load, skipping the menu scene.

fileNodes.name: WaterLevelEnabler.cs
fileNodes.summary: Enables the water-body visual group matching the current WorldState.WaterState (flood, full, shallow, puddles, or post-flood) at Start and disables all other groups.

fileNodes.name: WeightyObjectStack.cs
fileNodes.summary: Weight-capped LIFO stack for carried/stored weighty objects backed by a ReactiveUnity ReactiveStack, with a container interface for world objects that accept pushed weighty objects.

fileNodes.name: WeightyObjectType.cs
fileNodes.summary: Defines the weighty-object concept: IWeighty ties carryable objects to interaction (InteractInput.IInteractable) and saving (SaveData.ISaveable); StoredWeightyObject snapshots a carried object's type and save data; WeightyObjectType ScriptableObject holds weight, strength requirement, and N/S-E/W carry sprites.

fileNodes.name: WorldObjectOccupancyMap.cs
fileNodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that treats a Tilemap as a spatial occupancy grid. CheckOccupied queries for marker tiles at a world or cell position; SetOccupied paints a rectangular footprint of marker tiles and returns an eraser callback for later release.

fileNodes.name: WorldState.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject holding global environmental state as static ReactiveUnity properties: WaterState (Puddles/Flood/Full/Shallow/PostFlood), RainState, WindState, plus a static outside Temperature. Other systems subscribe to the reactives.

fileNodes.name: WorldStateByCalendar.cs
fileNodes.summary: WorldStateCalendar MonoBehaviour with a hand-authored list of DayState entries (year/day/season -> water/rain/wind). On every GameClock game-day tick it looks up the current date and writes the matching state into WorldState; logs an error and falls back to Shallow if no entry matches.

fileNodes.name: YDepthSorter.cs
fileNodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that derives a GameObject's sprite/SortingGroup/Canvas sorting order from its world Y position (negative Y = higher order), adding per-layer offsets for GroundObstacle, LowObstacle, HighObstacle, and Birds layers. Sorts on enable/start and optionally every frame.

fileNodes.name: BirdAnimatorController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Drives a bird's Animator: builds a per-species AnimatorOverrideController from BirdSpeciesData clips, plays tagged vs untagged animation variants, supports flapping/gliding/two-hop animations via coroutine, and flips the sprite to match facing direction.

fileNodes.name: BirdBehaviourConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject tuning pack for the bird state machine: flocking reaction cooldown and reaction-time range, circle-cast avoidance parameters, and one parameters struct per bird state (LowFlying, LowLanding, Sheltered, Perched, Grounded, Fleeing, HighFlying, HighLanding).

fileNodes.name: BirdBrain.cs
fileNodes.summary: Partial MonoBehaviour that is the bird AI controller. Owns the IBirdState state machine (eight nested state classes spread across sibling files), per-bird instance/tag data, flock reaction logic (reacting to nearby birds' state changes), tag animation, world-exit respawning, and helper queries for landing spots, water, and obstacles.

fileNodes.name: FleeingState.cs
fileNodes.summary: BirdBrain state that flees from the player: computes a flee direction away from the player collider, adds flee + avoidance forces, clamps to max speed, and returns to LowFlying once the behaviour timer elapses.

fileNodes.name: GroundedState.cs
fileNodes.summary: Ground behaviour state: alternates between moving and idling, choosing walk, two-hop, or swim depending on config and whether the bird is on a deep-water tile. Enables ground/water collision while grounded and disables it on exit.

fileNodes.name: HighFlyingState.cs
fileNodes.summary: High-altitude flight state: excludes low obstacles and people from collision, applies wander steering force on an interval, and on timer expiry chooses between descending to LowFlying or starting a HighLanding.

fileNodes.name: HighLandingState.cs
fileNodes.summary: Descending-landing state: picks a perch or ground spot inside a landing circle (preferring high-elevation perches), seeks toward it, and snaps/teleports to the target on timeout or proximity before handing off to Perched/Grounded/HighFlying.

fileNodes.name: LandingState.cs
fileNodes.summary: Low-flight landing state: picks a perch, shelter, or ground target in the landing area by preference, glides in with seek + avoidance forces, warps around obstacles if stuck, and snaps to the target before entering the chosen state.

fileNodes.name: LowFlyingState.cs
fileNodes.summary: Default low-altitude flight state combining wander, boid/flocking, and avoidance steering forces. On timer expiry it rolls between Landing and HighFlying using configured preferences.

fileNodes.name: PerchedState.cs
fileNodes.summary: State where the bird sits on a perchable landing spot: notifies the spot on entry/exit, freezes rigidbody constraints, then returns to LowFlying or HighFlying depending on the previous state.

fileNodes.name: ShelteredState.cs
fileNodes.summary: State where the bird hides inside a shelterable object: hides all child renderers, disables the sorting group, plays a leaf-splash particle effect, freezes constraints, and later returns to LowFlying.

fileNodes.name: BirdElevationVisualTweaks.cs
fileNodes.summary: Visual proxy that maps the bird's current state to an elevation level (grounded/low/high): lerps the bird and shadow Y positions and opacities, and triggers flapping/gliding animations. Landing states lerp elevation over the distance to the target.

fileNodes.name: BirdFrightDetector.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger collider that frightens a bird when the player enters, unless the bird is already sheltered, fleeing, or high flying. Finds the single player collider on Awake.

fileNodes.name: BirdMaterialController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Manages the bird's outline-shader material: wipes between base/highlight/mask outline states via an angular wipe driven from the sprite pivot UV, locks states during the tag highlight, and reacts to the bird's IsTagged reactive.

fileNodes.name: BirdOutliner.cs
fileNodes.summary: Occlusion helper: a frame-mask trigger switches a bird's outline to Base or Mask depending on which side of a frame mask it stands, and masks the outline when it leaves the trigger.

fileNodes.name: BirdSceneSaveManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject that persists per-scene bird spawn state (spawn X/Y, tagged flag, species name) as JSON (Newtonsoft) keyed by scene name, with save/load/clear operations.

fileNodes.name: BirdSeasonSpawnData.cs
fileNodes.summary: Empty placeholder file with no source code and no types. A serializable class of the same name actually lives nested inside BirdSpawner.cs and carries the per-season/week spawn configuration.

fileNodes.name: BirdSounds.cs
fileNodes.summary: Ambient bird calls: plays a random sound from a list at random intervals, with volume scaled down by distance from the player between the full-volume and silence radii.

fileNodes.name: BirdSpawner.cs
fileNodes.summary: Spawns birds per season and week from inspector-authored spawn data (species, count, tilemap areas). Restores saved spawn positions when the week data still matches, otherwise picks new points in the spawn tilemaps outside the camera view, and saves all living birds on disable.

fileNodes.name: BirdSpeciesData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject describing one bird species: name, prefab, flockable species list, icon, spawnable seasons/periods, behaviour config reference, base animator controller with per-species clip overrides, and capture sound.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/BirdingGame.cs
fileNodes.summary: The birding minigame HUD. The player charges a frame meter by holding the UseBinoculars input action; on release the frame is caught and bounces to a stop (critically damped spring), then a cursor sweeps across the bird view and the player presses the action again to tag a bird under it. The HUD rotates to track the mouse angle. A legacy joystick-driven rotation variant is preserved in commented-out KEEP blocks.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/BirdingWinFrame.cs
fileNodes.summary: One-shot 'NICE!' celebration overlay for the birding minigame: shows the tagged bird's icon, plays an animator clip, and deactivates itself when the clip finishes.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/NearbyBirdTracker.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tracks which BirdBrain instances are within a bird's trigger view range, exposing them as a read-only collection. Keeps the set in sync on trigger enter/exit and on the global BirdBrain.BirdDestroyed event.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Birding/SetBirdingOpacityGradient.cs
fileNodes.summary: Keeps a birding HUD material's shader property _GradientOriginPosition pinned to an origin transform every frame so the opacity gradient follows the HUD; resets the property to zero on destroy.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/BootstrapperConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject asset that declares which prefabs the scene bootstrapper should spawn, grouped by persistence (persistent DontDestroyOnLoad, all scenes, inside scenes, outside scenes).

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShed.cs
fileNodes.summary: The abandoned shed: an interactable that can be repaired stage by stage (requires a hammer plus materials from the player inventory), serves as an infinite bird perch, and has vines the player chops with an axe that shake via DOTween and, once fully chopped, spawn items and are hidden.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShedData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject holding the shed's shared mutable state: how many repair stages have been done, whether the vines are destroyed, and the names of repaired parts (consumed by the interior to switch visuals).

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Buildings/AbandonedShedInterior.cs
fileNodes.summary: On start, reads the shed data to reflect repairs in the interior: a repaired roof or dry weather disables the rain particles and puddle, a repaired roof disables the roof light, and a repaired floor swaps the sprite.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/DialogueController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Speech-bubble controller for NPCs: renders one message at a time into a PixelTextRenderer child, holds it for a configurable duration, then fades it out alpha by alpha.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/Gerard.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject tracking Gerard's rescue arc: a three-stage state (UnconsciousBeach, UnconsciousShed, AwakeShed) that advances one step on each player sleep once the ReadyForNextState flag has been set.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/IGiftable.cs
fileNodes.summary: Declares the IGiftReceiving interface: NPCs that can accept item gifts. It extends UseItemInput.IUsableTarget and requires a TryGiveGift(Inventory.Item) implementation that reports acceptance.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/ShedGerard.cs
fileNodes.summary: The awake variant of Gerard near the shed. It activates only when Gerard.State is AwakeShed, shows cycling dialogue lines chosen by location (inside/outside) and game hour, and after a couple of outside chats sets ReadyForNextState to progress the arc.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Characters/UnconsciousGerard.cs
fileNodes.summary: The passed-out Gerard lying on the beach or in the shed. It shows starving flavour dialogue, accepts acceptable food gifts through IGiftReceiving, and once fed enough it reads fed messages, then falls asleep (so only the Narrator comments).

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/BasicWeapon.cs
fileNodes.summary: Defines RangedWeaponItem, a ScriptableObject inventory item for projectile weapons. It holds fire-rate, reload, clip, and a projectile prefab, and exposes per-usage InstanceData (reload/cooldown reactive flags, clip count, spawn transform, target collider). TryFire spawns a pooled projectile aimed at the mouse or a locked-on target.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/BowChargeController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Charge-choreography controller for the bow. While charging it locks the player into the Combat action map, fills a HUD frame, tints the frame via MaterialPropertyBlock shader override by charge tier (normal/crit), then on release fires a pooled projectile with speed scaled by charge, applies crit damage and energy cost, and ends with a cooldown gate.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/ContactHitbox.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger hitbox placed on weapons, projectiles, and enemies that deals damage to anything implementing IHurtBox. Validates targets by layer pairing (enemy hitbox vs friendly hurtbox and vice versa), applies knockback in self/target/both modes, and exposes an OnHit event.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyActiveWeapon.cs
fileNodes.summary: Fires a RangedWeaponItem for an enemy: builds the weapon's InstanceData pointing at a target collider and the enemy transform as spawn center, registers it with the Reloader, and calls TryFire every frame while firing is enabled.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyHealth.cs
fileNodes.summary: Enemy health component: ReactiveUnity current health initialized to max on enable, TakeDamage with timed invulnerability frames, Heal with clamp, death via Destroy, and a gizmo-drawn health bar for editor visualization.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/EnemyHurtbox.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger collider marking an enemy as damageable: resolves the parent EnemyHealth on enable, exposes vulnerability from its invulnerability flag, and forwards TakeDamage calls to it.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/FlyingChaser.cs
fileNodes.summary: Flying enemy AI that wanders with steering wander force, detects the player within a view radius with line-of-sight checks, then chases with seek + obstacle avoidance; taking damage makes it permanently aggressive. Gizmos visualize view radius, wander ring, and forces.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/IHurtBox.cs
fileNodes.summary: The damage-receiver contract used across combat: anything with TakeDamage(float) and an IsVulnerable flag can be hit by a ContactHitbox.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/KnockbackMode.cs
fileNodes.summary: Enumeration of how a ContactHitbox applies knockback: no knockback, knock the hitbox owner, knock the target, or both.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/PlayerActiveWeapon.cs
fileNodes.summary: Watches the player's active inventory slot via ReactiveUnity; whenever the active item is a RangedWeaponItem, its instance data (with spawn center at the weapon's transform) is handed to the Reloader, and nulled when it is not.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/Projectile.cs
fileNodes.summary: Pooled projectile that launches at a velocity, dies on lifespan timeout or when it hits a Default-layer collider, and is returned to the pool after hitting a target. Supports a crit variant that doubles the hitbox damage and turns the sprite yellow.

fileNodes.name: Assets/Scripts/Combat/ProjectileFiringEnemy.cs
fileNodes.summary: Configurable enemy that keeps the player at a comfortable firing range and executes one of six projectile patterns: single, spread, parallel, burst, aimed (charged, telegraphed red), and ring shot. It idles with wandering, engages with distance-band movement, and becomes permanently aggressive on taking damage.

fileNodes.name: ReloadBar.cs
fileNodes.summary: In-world progress bar for ranged weapon reloading. Subscribes to the Reloader's active weapon instance data via ReactiveUnity OnChange, shows/scales a child SpriteRenderer to the reload progress each frame while IsReloading is true.

fileNodes.name: Reloader.cs
fileNodes.summary: Drives reload and fire-cooldown timers for the player's currently equipped ranged weapon. In FixedUpdate it advances ReloadElapsed/CoolDownElapsed on the weapon's InstanceData and flips IsReloading/IsCoolingDown Reactive flags when complete, refilling the clip.

fileNodes.name: SteeringForces.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static library of steering behaviors for enemy/bird AI: Seek, a wander force with a projected ring, obstacle avoidance via CircleCast, a Reynolds-style boid force (separation/alignment/cohesion over nearest IFlockMate neighbors), and a collision-mask helper that derives interaction layers from the rigidbody and layer matrix.

fileNodes.name: FishBarTrigger.cs
fileNodes.summary: A trigger zone on the fishing minigame bar. Reports when the rising cursor passes it (OnTriggerExit2D sends PassedFishBarTrigger up the hierarchy), toggles a fulfilled/unfulfilled sprite, and optionally oscillates up and down within clamped bounds at a FishingRound-configured speed.

fileNodes.name: FishType.cs
fileNodes.summary: Config ScriptableBehaviour-style component describing a catchable fish: which scenes it can be caught in, the Inventory.Item it grants, spawnable seasons/day periods, and a list of FishingRound minigame difficulty configs (speed, trigger count/spacing, stacking modifier, oscillation).

fileNodes.name: FishingGame.cs
fileNodes.summary: The fishing minigame. Picks a valid FishType for the current scene/season/period, runs one or more rounds where a rising cursor passes trigger bars the player must time with the use key, handles hit/miss detection via Overlap, and on win awards the fish item + capture-log entry while on fail shakes and launches the cursor.

fileNodes.name: Axe.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject axe item. Sets the player to the Axing state and triggers OnUseAxe on world objects that implement IUseableWithAxe (trees/stumps), playing a chop sound; costs energy.

fileNodes.name: Binoculars.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject binoculars item that switches the player into the Birding state and starts the birding minigame via BirdingGame.Instance.Play(this), passing beam rotation/acceleration and charge/cursor timing settings; costs energy.

fileNodes.name: Bow.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject bow ranged weapon. On use, hands off to BowChargeController.StartCharge when a projectile spawn point exists (charged shots with crit window), otherwise fires immediately via TryFire; exposes charge time, min-speed multiplier, and crit-shot charge range.

fileNodes.name: DryLog.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject dry-log item placed on world objects: loads into a LarchStump or adds to a WoodRack, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.

fileNodes.name: Firewood.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject firewood item that adds fuel to a WoodStove or Campfire, consuming the active inventory item and playing a placement sound on success.

fileNodes.name: Fly Agaric 1.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 1). Edible food: removing the active item and calling Diet.EatFood against the player's energy manager to recover protein/carbs/nutrients.

fileNodes.name: Fly Agaric 2.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom variant (fly agaric 2). Edible food: removes the active item and feeds it to the player's energy manager via Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients.

fileNodes.name: Fly Agaric.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject fly-agaric mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients to the player via Diet.EatFood.

fileNodes.name: Hammer.cs
fileNodes.summary: Empty ScriptableObject hammer item marker used for gifting/crafting progression; carries no behavior beyond being an Inventory.Item.

fileNodes.name: Kokanee.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject kokanee salmon item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets like NPCs via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients).

fileNodes.name: Larch Bolete 2.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 2). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.

fileNodes.name: Larch Bolete 3.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom variant (bolete 3). Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.

fileNodes.name: Larch Bolete.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject larch bolete mushroom item. Edible food: consumes the active item and feeds protein/carbs/nutrients via Diet.EatFood; zero energy cost.

fileNodes.name: LooseItem.cs
fileNodes.summary: World-space dropped item holding an Inventory.ItemStack and an animator; becomes magnetically attractable to the player once its animation reaches the Idle state (so it can't be grabbed mid-drop).

fileNodes.name: RainbowTrout.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject rainbow trout item. Both a gift (UseOnWorldObject hands it to IGiftReceiving targets via TryGiveGift) and an edible food (Diet.EatFood for protein/carbs/nutrients); zero energy cost.

fileNodes.name: Rod.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject fishing rod item used on tilemaps: casting on the Water tilemap starts fishing (FishingGame.CastForFish) while already fishing reels the line in, toggling the player between Fishing and Idle states; costs energy.

fileNodes.name: Sling.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject sling ranged weapon that fires instantly on use via RangedWeaponItem.TryFire, with a per-shot energy cost.

fileNodes.name: SpawnLooseItemsOnDestroy.cs
fileNodes.summary: Spawns configured loose items from a collider when the object is disabled, unless disabled by a scene unload (checks gameObject.scene.isLoaded); items are launched with velocity and drag. Named OnDestroy but hooks OnDisable to exclude scene-exit destruction.

fileNodes.name: WetLog.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject wet-log item. Trying to burn it on a WoodStove/Campfire posts a 'too wet to burn' dialogue message, while placing it on a WoodRack dries it (TryAddWetLog), consuming the active item.

fileNodes.name: AnimateTitle.cs
fileNodes.summary: Title-screen text that breathes: stores the original local scale in Awake and in every Update oscillates transform.localScale around it with Mathf.Sin(Time.time * _speed) * _scaleFactor.

fileNodes.name: BlinkRepeatedly.cs
fileNodes.summary: Blinks a PixelTextRenderer by looping forever in a Start coroutine: shows the original text, waits _visibleInterval, clears Text to empty, waits _invisibleInterval, then restores it.

fileNodes.name: KeepChildScaleUnflipped.cs
fileNodes.summary: Keeps a child sprite visually unflipped when its parent is mirrored: in LateUpdate it rewrites local scale to the initial magnitude times the sign of each parent axis.

fileNodes.name: PulseLight.cs
fileNodes.summary: Breathes a URP 2D Light2D's intensity between _minIntensity and _maxIntensity every frame by stepping the intensity; SetIntensity retunes the range and snaps intensity to the new minimum.

fileNodes.name: StartGame.cs
fileNodes.summary: Title-screen handler that loads the 'Level 1' scene through SmoothSceneManager when the Space key is pressed in Update.

fileNodes.name: AsepriteEventListener.cs
fileNodes.summary: Bridges Animator event callbacks from Aseprite player animations to configurable local transform offsets: each Effect pairs an affected GameObject with an event name (airborne, grounded, squats, pickups) and an offset; originals are snapshotted on enable and the same event drives offsetting.

fileNodes.name: CaptureLog.cs
fileNodes.summary: Serializable capture journal shared by fishing and birding. AddToLog stamps a CaptureEntry with the full GameClock timestamp (year, season, day, hour, minute) and reports first captures; queries count totals, unique names, per-name totals, per-week counts, a 4x3 season/week presence table, and existence checks.

fileNodes.name: CarriedObjectsAnimatorController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Displays the carried weighty-object stack: subscribes to the PlayerCarry stack's StoredObjects reactive list and rebuilds child SpriteRenderers, showing NSCarry sprites for each stored object and hiding unused children.

fileNodes.name: Diet.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static nutrition helper. EatFood clamps today's protein/carbs/nutrients into PlayerEnergyManager against the daily 100-point requirements and narrates the nutrition breakdown; ResetDailyIntake zeroes the daily totals; GetRecoveryRatio averages intake ratios and GetRecoveryMessage picks a hunger flavor line.

fileNodes.name: EnergyBar.cs
fileNodes.summary: HUD energy bar: resizes an Image's width to (CurrentEnergy / MaxEnergy) * max width. Subscribes to PlayerEnergyManager.CurrentEnergy on enable and unsubscribes on disable.

fileNodes.name: HUDInputManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Maps hotbar input to the active inventory slot: OnItemSelect1..10 set the slot directly, and left/right cursor actions step the slot index with wraparound by writing Inventory.ActiveItemSlot.

fileNodes.name: InteractInput.cs
fileNodes.summary: Interact action handler: only acts when the player is idle or running, resolves the GridCursor grid position, finds an IInteractable there, refuses non-weighty interactions while carrying, and calls CursorInteract on the target. Logs each attempt via Logger.

fileNodes.name: Inventory.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject inventory of 10 slots mapping slot index to ItemStack. Stacks quantities into existing slots then empty slots, removes from smallest stacks, swaps slots, and persists to JSON (InventoryData.json in persistentDataPath) including per-instance item data. Active slot is a Reactive<int>; overflow items are dropped on the ground via SpawnItems.

fileNodes.name: PlayerAnimatorController.cs
fileNodes.summary: Drives the player's three animators (default, wheelbarrow, carrying) from PlayerMovement state/direction plus carry, wheelbarrow and inventory signals. Subscribes to reactive PlayerState, Direction, carried stack, wheelbarrow and active-slot changes, maps PlayerStates to named clips (S_Idle, S_Running_Axe, SE_Pickup, S_Chopping, etc.), mirrors the body west-facing, and auto-returns to idle after timed actions.

fileNodes.name: PlayerAudioManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Singleton for playing player SFX through a pool of AudioSources on a shared root. PlayOneShot and PlayLooping route SoundData to the next free source (adding one when all are busy); looping returns an Action to stop the loop.

fileNodes.name: PlayerCaptureLogs.cs
fileNodes.summary: ISaveableComponent persisting the player's birding and fishing CaptureLogs: serializes both capture tables to JSON and restores them back into the in-memory logs.

fileNodes.name: PlayerCarry.cs
fileNodes.summary: Manages carrying a stack of weighty objects. TryPickUpWeightyObject sets the PickingUp state then pushes after a short delay; PutDown and drop-on-hit spawn the object back into the world at an unoccupied cell near the cursor/player; Push registers the pickup with PlayerStrength; every drop plays a put-down sound.

fileNodes.name: PlayerCrouch.cs
fileNodes.summary: Toggles the Crouched player state while the Crouch input action is held: enters from Idle/Running on started, returns to Idle on canceled. Hooks Input System action callbacks in OnEnable/OnDisable.

fileNodes.name: PlayerCursor.cs
fileNodes.summary: World-facing player cursor snapped to the grid. One of four cursor objects (per compass direction) is shown and its collider enabled only when the player faces that direction and is idle or running; the render transform snaps to the grid cell each frame.

fileNodes.name: PlayerDialogue.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static-instance bridge so any system can push a message to the player's character DialogueController via PostMessage; delegates to the required DialogueController component.

fileNodes.name: PlayerDryingManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Wetness state machine (Wet/Dry/Drying/Wetting) driven by rain state and scene. Each game-minute tick accrues drying points at a rate set by ambient temperature; prolonged rain exposure makes the player wet; narrator messages announce transitions; drying pauses while asleep. Persists via ISaveableComponent.

fileNodes.name: PlayerEnergyManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Central player energy/diet/sleep state. Depletes and recovers energy against a max, tracks today's protein/carbs/nutrients, and Sleep() warms the player instantly, records the last sleep game time, and loads the SleepMenu scene. Persists energy, diet and sleep fields via ISaveableComponent.

fileNodes.name: PlayerHealth.cs
fileNodes.summary: Player health with damage absorption: taking damage while carrying drops a carried (or wheelbarrow) item instead of losing health; otherwise health depletes with invulnerability frames and a red flash on the active sprite. Death posts a narrator line.

fileNodes.name: PlayerHurtbox.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger collider component exposing IHurtBox on the player: reports vulnerability from PlayerHealth's IsInvulnerable and forwards TakeDamage to the parent PlayerHealth.

fileNodes.name: PlayerMovement.cs
fileNodes.summary: Player movement core: reads move input, derives an 8-way CompassDirection and transitions PlayerStates (Idle/Running, Birding/BirdingRunning, BowCharging/BowChargingRunning), applies cardinal max speeds with per-axis multipliers, and accelerates via Vector2.MoveTowards in FixedUpdate. Carrying and wheelbarrow reduce acceleration and top speed per carried object. Also defines the CompassDirection enum and CardinalVector struct used across the project.

fileNodes.name: PlayerMovementData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject tuning asset for player movement: default and wheelbarrow move speeds, base acceleration/deceleration, and per-carried-object reductions to speed and acceleration. Consumed by the player movement controller so carrying and wheelbarrowing feel heavier.

fileNodes.name: PlayerSceneData.cs
fileNodes.summary: Persistent scene/position state on the player. Exposes static pending-spawn fields that scene transitions set before loading, and implements ISaveableComponent to capture/restore transform position and scene-on-awake across saves.

fileNodes.name: PlayerSoundManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Plays looping footstep and wheelbarrow-rolling audio driven by player state. Subscribes to PlayerState and IsHoldingWheelBarrow Reactive properties, starts/stops looping SoundData handles, and cleans up subscriptions on disable.

fileNodes.name: PlayerStrength.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tracks permanent strength progression as the count of distinct carried objects ever picked up. New objects can raise the strength level, which bumps carry capacity on the player's WeightyObjectStack and posts a Narrator level-up message; persists via ISaveableComponent.

fileNodes.name: PlayerTemperatureManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Core player temperature model. Maintains a dry temperature that drifts one step toward ambient every 60 game-minutes and an actual temperature that drops one step below dry while the player is wet. Ticks on GameClock, narrates temperature changes, extends HeatSensitive to read ambient heat sources, and persists state.

fileNodes.name: PlayerWheelBarrow.cs
fileNodes.summary: Lets the player pick up a static wheelbarrow (transferring its WeightyObjectStack contents), carry it while switching the input action map to 'PlayerBarrowing', and put it back down as a new static wheelbarrow facing the player's direction. Plays lift/place sounds and moves contents between stacks.

fileNodes.name: SleepQuality.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static lookup of sleep recovery tuning keyed by sleeping temperature: awake hour, narrator recovery message, energy recovery ratio, and a past-curfew penalty applied when going to bed at or after 23:00.

fileNodes.name: StrengthData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject defining strength level tiers: pickups required, carry capacity granted, and a level-up message. Provides reverse lookup of the highest reached level for a pickup count and clamped level config access.

fileNodes.name: ToggleMenuInput.cs
fileNodes.summary: Toggles a game menu GameObject and swaps the PlayerInput action map between 'Player' and 'Menu' on the OnToggleMenu input action; also closes any active menu on Start.

fileNodes.name: LevelChanger.cs
fileNodes.summary: Scene transition trigger/interactable. On player trigger or cursor interaction it sets PlayerSceneData pending spawn fields, plays a sound, and loads the target scene via SmoothSceneManager; also provides static ChangeLevel helpers taking a SceneNames enum or string.

fileNodes.name: RodPlacement.cs
fileNodes.summary: Minimal marker component exposing a RodToPlace GameObject used by the fishing rod placement flow.

fileNodes.name: SceneNames.cs
fileNodes.summary: Enumeration of every scene name in the project (Boot, Outside, River0, the canyon/cave/forest network scenes, menu/HUD/Narrator scenes, Win, Lobby), used to type scene references across the codebase.

fileNodes.name: SceneSpawnConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject mapping scenes and named spawn points to positions. Lookups fall back to a default spawn (first entry) for a scene, then to the whole config's first scene when the requested scene isn't listed.

fileNodes.name: SceneTransitionOverlay.cs
fileNodes.summary: A persistent (DontDestroyOnLoad) overlay that animates scene transitions: fades in, loads the target scene asynchronously, fades back out, then destroys itself. Lives on this persistent MonoBehaviour so the loading coroutine survives scene loads.

fileNodes.name: SmoothSceneManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static helper (OysterUtils namespace) that saves the current scene via SceneSaveLoadManager, stamps a scene-save suffix, instantiates the scene-transition-overlay prefab from Resources, and triggers a smooth load into the target scene.

fileNodes.name: BiomeConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject defining a The Way North biome: a weighted pool of scenes, a list of fork scenes, and how many pool scenes play before a fork scene.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorth.cs
fileNodes.summary: The Way North procedural zone system. Generates a binary tree of biome nodes (weighted scenes per biome, left/right forks), tracks traversal through a scene path with return links between exits and entrances, drives transitions via SmoothSceneManager, and persists/restores the whole network through ISaveableComponent. Resolves player spawns from exit/entrance GameObjects at runtime.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorthConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject configuring The Way North: start scene, biome list, network depth, per-depth biome pools, and a debug always-regenerate flag. Provides weighted picks for scenes/biomes and helpers to find biomes and enumerate all zone scene names.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorthEntrance.cs
fileNodes.summary: Marks a scene entrance in a The Way North scene; the entrance id is the GameObject name. Looks up a labeled TheWayNorthSpawn child and draws an editor gizmo.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorthExit.cs
fileNodes.summary: Marks a scene exit in a The Way North scene, optionally tagged as a left/right fork direction. The exit id is the GameObject name; finds labeled spawn children and draws a gizmo.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorthSpawn.cs
fileNodes.summary: A labeled spawn point nested under a The Way North entrance or exit, used to position the player after a transition. Draws an editor gizmo.

fileNodes.name: TheWayNorthTransition.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger volume on an exit/entrance that routes the player to the The Way North manager: uses the parent TheWayNorthExit or TheWayNorthEntrance id and label to call TakeExit or UseEntrance, playing a sound first.

fileNodes.name: WeightedScene.cs
fileNodes.summary: Serializable pair of a SceneNames scene and a 0..1 weight used for weighted-random scene picks in The Way North biomes.

fileNodes.name: AdditiveUIScaler.cs
fileNodes.summary: Keeps an additive screen-space-camera canvas pixel-perfect by copying the DynamicPixelPerfectCamera's scale factor into the CanvasScaler every frame; wires the canvas to the main camera in Awake.

fileNodes.name: AssignUICamera.cs
fileNodes.summary: At runtime, finds the camera tagged 'UICamera' and assigns it as the canvas world camera. Runs early via DefaultExecutionOrder(-100) so other canvas-dependent scripts see the camera already set.

fileNodes.name: CinemachinePixelSnap.cs
fileNodes.summary: Cinemachine extension that snaps the camera position to the pixel grid during the Finalize pipeline stage so the pixel-art render stays crisp while tracking the player.

fileNodes.name: GameMenuManager.cs
fileNodes.summary: Simple page switcher for the pause-style menu: holds a list of page GameObjects, deactivates all on Start, and toggles between pages by index.

fileNodes.name: ItemSlot.cs
fileNodes.summary: Inventory hotbar/slot widget that renders item sprites and quantity labels, shows hover labels, highlights the active slot, and drives click-select plus drag-and-drop swapping against the player's Inventory.

fileNodes.name: Journal.cs
fileNodes.summary: The trail-of-the-brother journal UI: resolves the player's CaptureLog (birding/fishing) data, wires per-entry buttons, and renders an illustrated notebook page with title, catch counts, and a season-week date-dot grid for each selected entry.

fileNodes.name: JournalEntry.cs
fileNodes.summary: Selectable wrapper for a single journal entry row that forwards selection events to the owning Journal, adding a Button with an Image target graphic when missing.

fileNodes.name: LocalPositionOscillator.cs
fileNodes.summary: Sin-wave bobbing utility for UI/object local position, with per-axis amplitude, frequency, phase offset, optional unscaled time, and play/stop/reset control methods.

fileNodes.name: LocalRotationOscillator.cs
fileNodes.summary: Sin-wave rocking utility for local Z rotation, with amplitude in degrees, frequency, phase offset, unscaled-time support, and play/stop/reset controls — mirror of LocalPositionOscillator for rotation.

fileNodes.name: NotebookSprite.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tiny tag component that carries the sprite to display in the journal notebook for a species entry.

fileNodes.name: PixelCanvasTextRenderer.cs
fileNodes.summary: Pixel-art text renderer for the UI (Canvas) layer: lays out individual glyph Images from a PixelFont with alignment, word-wrap, color, and selectable state materials (normal/hovered/selected/pressed).

fileNodes.name: PixelFont.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject pixel font asset: a character-to-sprite lookup table with space width and tracking, providing glyph lookup, pixel-width measurement, and pixels-per-unit so renderers can lay out crisp pixel text.

fileNodes.name: PixelTextRenderer.cs
fileNodes.summary: Pixel-art text renderer for world-space objects: lays out pooled SpriteRenderer glyphs from a PixelFont with alignment, word-wrap, sorting order/layer, and color; the world-space sibling of PixelCanvasTextRenderer.

fileNodes.name: PlayerPage.cs
fileNodes.summary: Stub menu page for the player character panel — all content (diet bars, health/wetness/temperature text) is commented out and awaiting re-implementation.

fileNodes.name: TasksPage.cs
fileNodes.summary: Empty default MonoBehaviour template with unused Start/Update stubs — a placeholder for the menu's tasks page.

fileNodes.name: TopRightHUD.cs
fileNodes.summary: HUD clock/date/season widget in the top-right: renders 24h time and ordinal day into PixelCanvasTextRenderers and swaps a season frame sprite, all driven by GameClock tick events.

fileNodes.name: UIScalerSync.cs
fileNodes.summary: Keeps a Canvas scale factor matched to the pixel-perfect camera's current orthographic size so UI renders at the intended pixel density across resolutions.

fileNodes.name: AnimationHelper.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static extension helpers for Animator: looks up an AnimationClip's length by name from the runtime controller, warning when the controller or clip is missing.

fileNodes.name: Logger.cs
fileNodes.summary: Serializable configurable logging wrapper: Info/Verbose levels gated by inspector toggles, colorized rich-text prefixes, plus static helpers to flatten float arrays and MonoBehaviour game-object names.

fileNodes.name: Singleton.cs
fileNodes.summary: Generic MonoBehaviour singleton base: exposes a static Instance and auto-destroys duplicates while keeping the first across scenes via DontDestroyOnLoad.

fileNodes.name: SpawnOffset.cs
fileNodes.summary: Tag component carrying a spawn offset vector for entity placement, with an OnValidate warning if values exceed 1 unit (likely pixel confusion).

fileNodes.name: UniqueMaterialInstance.cs
fileNodes.summary: Gives a SpriteRenderer its own material instance (cloned from a source material with the sprite's texture bound) so per-entity material tweaks don't leak to other renderers.

fileNodes.name: ActiveWhenRaining.cs
fileNodes.summary: Toggles a list of components (Behaviour, Collider, Renderer, or ParticleSystem) on/off whenever the world rain state changes, so scenery reacts to weather without polling.

fileNodes.name: GlobalWindProperties.cs
fileNodes.summary: Pushes wind parameters (velocity, density, XY scaling, smooth-step) as global shader properties, optionally every frame, so all wind shaders react consistently.

fileNodes.name: RainAudio.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject rain audio manager: plays a looping rain SFX when the world is in HeavyRain, selecting interior vs heavy-exterior sound data based on the loaded scene, and switching audio on scene load.

fileNodes.name: SunLightControl.cs
fileNodes.summary: Drives a URP 2D Light2D through the day/night cycle: interpolates intensity and color across sunrise/sunset gradients from GameClock time, applies a rain overlay color, and supports coroutine-based fade in/out.

fileNodes.name: Wind.cs
fileNodes.summary: Wind system controller: loops wind audio, drives a ParticleSystemForceField, bends tree materials (spruce/larch) during gusts, and modulates the player's movement speed multiplier by headwind/tailwind through a wind state machine.

fileNodes.name: Barrel.cs
fileNodes.summary: Barrel world object that displays a pair of binoculars on top until collected. Uses a Reactive<States> state machine (WithBinos/Normal) to swap sprites and destroy the child binoculars object, with SaveData.ISaveable persistence via extended save data.

fileNodes.name: BarrelBinos.cs
fileNodes.summary: Small interactable child component for the binoculars leaning on the Barrel: on cursor interact, tries to add the binoculars item to the player inventory, posts a dialogue message, then calls Barrel.RemoveBinoculars().

fileNodes.name: BeachedBoat.cs
fileNodes.summary: BeachedBoat world object showing a damaged boat with a hammer leaning against it. Reactive state machine (DamagedWithHammer/Damaged/Normal) swaps sprites and removes the child hammer object; persists BoatState through SaveData extended data.

fileNodes.name: BigRock.cs
fileNodes.summary: Perchable world object for birds (BirdBrain.IPerchableLowElevation): tracks a list of child collider perches, reserves free perch slots for birds, and provides a random point inside a perch's bounds for landing.

fileNodes.name: BoatHammer.cs
fileNodes.summary: Interactable child of BeachedBoat: the hammer leaning against the boat has its own collider; interacting adds the hammer item to inventory and tells the boat to remove it.

fileNodes.name: BorderTree.cs
fileNodes.summary: Border tree decoration that swaps between summer/fall/dead adult sprites based on a Reactive<TreeStates> value. Purely cosmetic; maps state to a SpriteRenderer sprite.

fileNodes.name: Box.cs
fileNodes.summary: Quest delivery box: the player deposits WeightyObjectType items into a WeightyObjectStack; when the first required object's quantity is fulfilled, plays a win animation, fades out the blurb, and spawns the configured prize. Includes an item-request blurb with remaining count, alert badge, DOTween shake, and SaveData persistence.

fileNodes.name: BoxData.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject asset configuring a Box quest: a list of RequiredObject (WeightyObjectType + quantity), a prize prefab with spawn offset, and a nested IBoxPrize interface that prize prefabs implement to award rewards.

fileNodes.name: BoxLidCollider.cs
fileNodes.summary: Trigger collider on the Box lid that watches for the Player to enter/exit and drives the box's open/close animation via Box.OnPlayerProximityEnter/Exit.

fileNodes.name: Campfire.cs
fileNodes.summary: Campfire survival object with a fire lifecycle (Dead/Ready/Hot/Embers) advanced by GameClock game-minute ticks. Interact to light a Ready fire, AddFirewood to stoke/extend it; Hot/Embers emit warmth via LocalHeatSource and pulsing light; persists state and fire-duration counter.

fileNodes.name: FallenLarch.cs
fileNodes.summary: Concrete larch variant of FallenTree: implements Save/Load for the shared fallen-tree state (Idle/Falling) using SaveData extended data and restores the idle animation state on load.

fileNodes.name: FallenSpruce.cs
fileNodes.summary: Concrete spruce variant of FallenTree: implements Save/Load for the shared fallen-tree state using SaveData extended data; restores the idle sprite when loaded as Idle.

fileNodes.name: FallenTree.cs
fileNodes.summary: Abstract axe-choppable fallen tree. Plays an east/west falling animation (DOTween shake, collider disabled while falling) then settles into Idle. Takes five axe hits to destroy; used by FallenLarch and FallenSpruce.

fileNodes.name: FirewoodPile.cs
fileNodes.summary: Interactable firewood pile: taking a log decrements a Reactive<int> count, swaps sprites per remaining count, and grants Firewood items to the inventory; destroys itself when empty. Save/Load persists remaining logs.

fileNodes.name: GenericWeightyObject.cs
fileNodes.summary: Generic pickup for weighty objects (IWeighty): on cursor interact, hands itself to PlayerCarry.TryPickUpWeightyObject and destroys itself after a short delay; persists via a GUID PersistentID assigned on first save.

fileNodes.name: Larch.cs
fileNodes.summary: Larch tree subclass of TreePlant with SaveData.ISaveable: persists the shared TreeStates reactive state (summer/fall/dead) via extended save data.

fileNodes.name: LarchStump.cs
fileNodes.summary: Multi-state larch stump for firewood crafting: can hold an axe, hold a dry log, and split the log with the axe (splitting animation spawns three loose firewood). Also a low-elevation bird perch. Cursor interact retrieves the axe or dry log; Save/Load persists state.

fileNodes.name: LogPile.cs
fileNodes.summary: Interactable log pile: taking a log decrements a Reactive<int> count, swaps sprites per remaining count, and adds the log item to inventory; destroys itself when empty. Structurally identical to FirewoodPile but yields logs instead of firewood.

fileNodes.name: MountedRod.cs
fileNodes.summary: Inventory item (extends Inventory.Item) representing a fishing rod to mount on a water tile; UseItemOnInteractableTileMap checks for a Water tilemap layer and calls the currently stubbed PlaceRod.

fileNodes.name: PlacedMountedRod.cs
fileNodes.summary: Placed fishing rod on water (one of four facing prefabs): a bobber randomly toggles fishOn state on a timer, shakes, and shows on/off plus selected sprites. Interacting with a fish-on rod stops the timer, launches the FishingGame, and destroys the rod; persists fishOn state.

fileNodes.name: SleepingPad.cs
fileNodes.summary: Simple interactable sleeping pad: cursor interact calls PlayerEnergyManager.Sleep() to end the day; persists its transform so it survives scene saves.

fileNodes.name: Spruce.cs
fileNodes.summary: Spruce tree subclass of TreePlant with SaveData.ISaveable: persists the shared TreeStates reactive state via extended save data.

fileNodes.name: SpruceStump.cs
fileNodes.summary: Purely decorative spruce stump with a single-state reactive sprite swap and Save/Load persistence of that state.

fileNodes.name: StaticWheelBarrow.cs
fileNodes.summary: Static wheelbarrow the player can pick up (moving its WeightyObjectStack into PlayerWheelBarrow) when facing the right direction and not already carrying, or unload from one item at a time. Also implements BoxData.IBoxPrize to play a spawn-in animation when awarded as a quest prize.

fileNodes.name: StaticWheelBarrowSelector.cs
fileNodes.summary: Helper on the wheelbarrow parent: holds the facing direction (SouthEast/SouthWest) and mirrors the local scale to match, so the pickup logic can gate interaction by player direction.

fileNodes.name: TreePlant.cs
fileNodes.summary: Abstract base class for choppable, seasonal trees. Trees take 5 axe hits (via Axe.IUseableWithAxe) then fall, swapping in a stump and fallen-tree prefab; they swap sprite and material by TreeStates season state (windy material for summer/fall, standard lit when dead), shake on chopping/gusts/bird landings, and act as a bird shelter target (BirdBrain.IShelterable).

fileNodes.name: WeightyObjectStackConfig.cs
fileNodes.summary: ScriptableObject config for a weighty-object container (e.g. a wheelbarrow): a weight capacity plus insert/remove SoundData for audio feedback.

fileNodes.name: WheelBarrowContainedSprites.cs
fileNodes.summary: MonoBehaviour that mirrors a wheelbarrow's WeightyObjectStack contents onto its child SpriteRenderers, picking the north-south or east-west carry sprite based on the wheelbarrow's facing direction.

fileNodes.name: WoodRack.cs
fileNodes.summary: Firewood storage rack holding wet and dry logs. Implements InteractInput.IInteractable, GameClock.ITickable, and SaveData.ISaveable: wet logs dry over in-game minutes (drying faster when the rack sits in a Warm/Hot heat zone), dry logs can be removed into the inventory, and the rack sprite swaps by fill level with narrator feedback.

fileNodes.name: WoodStove.cs
fileNodes.summary: Stove with a fire state machine (Dead, Ready, Hot, Embers). Implements InteractInput.IInteractable, UseItemInput.IUsableTarget, GameClock.ITickable, and SaveData.ISaveable: firewood-loading and interaction drive state transitions, game minutes burn the fire Hot→Embers→Dead, and each state drives an Animator clip, LocalHeatSource (Warm), PulseLight intensity, and looping fire SFX.

fileNodes.name: Wedges.hlsl
fileNodes.summary: HLSL include (Shader Graph Custom Function) providing two antialiased wedge-mask functions — a circular wedge fill and a UV wedge cutout — used by birding shaders to draw radial wedge shapes and angle-range masks.

fileNodes.name: manifest.json
fileNodes.summary: Unity package manifest declaring project dependencies: Cinemachine 3.1.3 (camera), Unity Input System 1.18.0 (new input), URP 17.3.0 (2D rendering), 2D Animation 13.0.4, ugui 2.0.0, feature.2d 2.0.2, and the BlueOyster json-persistence-unity git package (ReactiveUnity + JSON save system). All standard com.unity.modules.* built-in modules are pinned to 1.0.0. DOTween is not here — it ships as a vendored package under Assets/.

layers.name: Systems Core
layers.description: Global infrastructure: scene bootstrap and prefab config, JSON persistence and the scene save/load contract, object pooling and world-object spawning, scene transitions and scene-name/spawn config, the global audio service (AudioManager, SoundData), the Input System action asset, and shared utility singletons/logging/helpers.

layers.name: Survival & Simulation
layers.description: The living-world simulation shared by player and environment: the GameClock time model, world state reactives (water/rain/wind) and their calendar driver, the heat-source abstraction and ambient temperature field, weather controllers (sun, wind, rain), flood damage and water-level visuals, and the sleep flow that closes each day.

layers.name: Player Systems
layers.description: Everything owned by the player character: movement, states, animator and cursor; health, energy/diet, temperature and drying survival meters; inventory, carried weighty objects, strength and wheelbarrow; the grid-cursor interact and item-use input drivers; item magnetism; player audio; and the capture-log data the journal renders.

layers.name: Combat & Enemies
layers.description: Weaponized combat and hostile AI: the bow and sling ranged-weapon items with charge choreography, the projectile and contact-hitbox damage model, hurtboxes and enemy health, reloading, and enemy behaviors (FlyingChaser, ProjectileFiringEnemy) built on shared steering forces.

layers.name: World Objects, Items & Buildings
layers.description: The interactable world: choppable/seasonal trees and stumps, firewood crafting (campfires, wood stoves, racks, log and firewood piles), quest boxes and wheelbarrows, beds, perches, carryable weighty objects with their occupancy and stack infrastructure, shed repair, and the non-combat inventory items (tools, logs, food, gifts) plus dropped loose items.

layers.name: Fishing System
layers.description: The fishing minigame and its domain: fish-type configs, minigame rounds and trigger bars, the rod item and rod placement flow, and mounted/placed rods that launch fishing.

layers.name: Birding System
layers.description: The birding minigame and bird AI: the binoculars item, the minigame HUD and win frame, the BirdBrain state machine with its eight states, spawner/species/behaviour ScriptableObjects, per-scene bird save, bird presentation (animator, outline material, sounds, elevation), and the wedge-mask shader include.

layers.name: UI & Rendering
layers.description: Presentation and rendering: the pixel-perfect camera and Cinemachine snap, sprite sorting/depth and material utilities, the pixel-font text renderers, HUD and menus (inventory slots, journal widget, clock HUD, menu pages), title-screen and misc visual helpers, and per-entity material isolation.

layers.name: Narrative & Characters
layers.description: Story and character layer: the Narrator text overlay, NPC speech-bubble dialogue, Gerard's rescue arc with its awake/unconscious variants, and the gift-receiving contract for NPCs.

layers.name: The Way North Zone System
layers.description: The Way North procedural zone system: biome and network config ScriptableObjects, the binary-tree network generator and persister, weighted scene picks, and the entrance/exit/spawn/transition markers that connect its scenes.

layers.name: Third-Party & Legacy
layers.description: Vendored third-party code and dead code: the shipped DOTween library (tween modules and bundled documentation) and archived legacy scripts that have been superseded.

layers.name: Project Config & Docs
layers.description: Repository-level documentation and tooling config: design and dev-guide docs, agent workflow docs, Unity project settings (editor version, build/Burst and scene-template config), and the package manifest and lockfile.
